items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT (blood clot/calf related). Eagles signing Joe Milton for depth; Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; ruled out earlier in week, confirmed on final lists.
items.implication: Eagles offense changes with backup QB; Saquon also out compounds.
items.opportunity: DeVonta Smith and other pass-catchers may see altered target share.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday’s game against the Panthers. Will Shipley also to IR.
items.why: Hamstring injury; sat practice and officially ruled out by team/Schefter.
items.implication: Major RB downgrade; Eagles backfield opens to backups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining RBs including Kenny Gainwell.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams. Resting for long-term healing.
items.why: Ankle injury; no practice, coach confirms rest for long-term.
items.implication: Cardinals RB committee shifts; limited fantasy upside remaining.
items.opportunity: More work for other Cardinals backs if any rostered.

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Ankle sprain; no practice all week per Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Ravens offense less explosive; Huntley start confirmed.
items.opportunity: Potential bump for Ravens pass-catchers in volume but lower ceiling.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed IN after upgrade to full/no designation; returns from hamstring/toe.
items.why: Upgraded practice participation; cleared on final report despite Hurts/Saquon outs.
items.implication: Primary WR target with backup QB; strong start candidate.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets in depleted Eagles offense.

items.why: Groin; DNPs leading to OUT designation.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other HOU backs.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT along with AD Mitchell.
items.why: Ongoing injury; week-to-week previously, confirmed OUT.
items.implication: Jets RB depth chart elevates backups.
items.opportunity: Handcuff or committee backs see full work.

items.text: AJ Brown is questionable for Patriots vs Jets.
items.why: Status up in the air per earlier comments; on final Q list.
items.implication: Monitor Saturday decision; high upside if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more targets to other NE WRs/RBs.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday’s game; full participant and expected to play.
items.why: Cleared after limited practices; no designation on final report.
items.implication: Full role expected vs KC; reverse any prior fade.
items.opportunity: High target share intact; Quentin Johnston also IN.

items.text: After another full practice, Bears QB Caleb Williams is officially questionable.
items.why: Hamstring; full participant Fri but still needs clearance.
items.implication: Game-time decision; strong matchup vs ATL if plays.
items.opportunity: If OUT, backup QB limits Bears skill players.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6 due to soft matchup and usage.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; elite volume expected.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share vs weak secondary.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI; WR6 ranking on bankable usage.
items.why: Reliable target share and favorable matchup themes.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets secure even with Penix back.

items.text: LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs leaky run defense.
items.why: Volume and goal-line work against defense allowing run production.
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone, and two-minute usage elevated.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28); ugly matchup and shaky QB situation.
items.why: Seattle tough on WRs; limited feeding recently.
items.implication: Fade/sit in favor of better matchups.
items.opportunity: Low expected targets/routes vs elite coverage.
